lede: Wat Kam Ko accounts for 43 catalogued manuscripts, 1 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Mae Hong Son (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (79%) are written in Shan · อักษรไทใหญ่ script. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (79%) over palm-leaf · ใบลาน (16%). Dated witnesses run 1852–1989 CE (19 of 43 carry a date).
